title: Ox Passion Rinbo Nic Salts E-Liquid 10ml
description: OX Passion Rinbo is a vibrant celebration of confectionery flavours. This complex blend captures the essence of chewy rainbow sweets, offering a multi-layered profile packed with varied fruit notes. The inhale introduces a mix of sweet and tangy Candy flavours, while the exhale leaves a sugary, colourful finish that provides a truly fun and engaging vape. Formulated with a perfectly balanced 50% VG / 50% PG ratio, this e-liquid provides excellent versatility for Mouth-to-Lung (MTL) devices. It pairs flawlessly with coils ranging from 1.2ohm to 0.8ohm, ensuring crisp flavour clarity and discreet vapour. The Nicotine Salt blend ensures a silky throat hit and rapid satisfaction. Developed by OXVA, a highly respected name in vaping hardware, the OX Passion Salts range offers a premium selection of e-liquids. These specialised blends are crafted to operate flawlessly with modern refillable vape devices, delivering a highly consistent vape. Available in 5mg, 10mg, and 20mg strengths.
